title: 16 of the most interesting startups from YC W26 Demo Day | TechCrunch
summary: 16 startups from YC Winter '26 Demo Day stood out, focusing on AI applications across various industries, including law, transportation, healthcare, and more. Notable mentions include Asimov's human movement data collection for humanoid training and Avoice's automation of non-design work in architecture firms.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights innovative AI startups with potential positive impacts on their respective industries, such as advancing humanoid technology and automating tedious tasks in architecture.
